summary: One T. spiralis muscle-larval extract, 12 SDS-PAGE gel slices (gel1-12.baf) acquired on a Bruker micrOTOF-Q II; instrument, search tolerances and modifications independently confirmed. Only minor findings.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent; producer transcript, report.md and prior reviews not read; evidence read only from scratchpad/bkk/<PXD>/ plus independent PRIDE FTP/OLS/Cellosaurus fetches

spec_compliance.evidence: 30 columns, 12 rows, ms-proteomics + invertebrates v1.1.0 declared and validated; required columns present; assay names unique; structured NT/AC values well-formed.

ontology_integrity.evidence: sdrf-tools check: 10/10 terms verified, CLEAN (MS:1000704 micrOTOF-Q II, MS:1001251, MS:1000133, PRIDE:0000568, PRIDE:0000627, UNIMOD:4/35). Only validator warning is 'whole organism' in organism part (UBERON synonym of multicellular organism).

source_evidence.evidence: Paper Methods (PMID 35558100): 12% SDS-PAGE, trypsin, Ultimate 3000, 'MicroToF Q II (Bruker)', Mascot 0.8/0.8 Da, variable carbamidomethylation and oxidation. Range-fetched first 3 MB of gel1.baf: 'micrOTOF-Q II' and otofControl; mgf header 'Instrument: micrOTOF-Q II'. PRIDE 'maXis' is correctly overridden.

file_mapping.evidence: files.json has 12 RAW (gel1-12.baf), all 12 mapped once; 12 mgf PEAK and F002725.dat SEARCH correctly excluded.

design_consistency.evidence: Single source, biological replicate 1, technical replicate 1, fraction identifier 1-12 matching gelN; no condition contrast so no factor value is defensible.

omission_safety.evidence: Reduction/alkylation 'not available' (not stated in paper); strain/sex 'not available' (not stated); developmental stage 'larval stage' supported by 'infective muscle larvae'. No unsupported specificity found.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf with the file's declared templates: exit 0, warnings only ('Most seems to be fine. There were only warnings.'); sdrf-tools check and score run; check CLEAN; score 95/100.

findings.message: 'whole organism' is not a UBERON label; consider 'multicellular organism' or keep as accepted synonym.
findings.evidence: validate-sdrf warning: not found in uberon;bto.

findings.message: No factor value column; acceptable for a single-condition catalogue but score flags design 67/100.
findings.evidence: sdrf-tools score design issue 'No factor value columns defined'.

findings.message: gelN = band/slice N order is inferred from file names; not stated in the paper.
findings.evidence: Paper reports SDS-PAGE bands 34->170 kDa but no slice numbering.
